name: Lagoon microalgae
desc: Microscopic algae, including salt-loving types, grow in sunlit lagoons. Brine shrimp feed on planktonic algae; flamingos also take diatoms and blue-green algae.
about: Dunaliella is a genus of single-celled, photosynthetic green algae, that is characteristic for its ability to thrive and outcompete other organisms in hypersaline environments.
